content.question: Why is the F-score calculated as the harmonic mean of precision and recall?
options: Because the harmonic mean gives attention to the lower value, whether it is precision or recall
Because the harmonic mean always equals the larger of the two values
Because the harmonic mean completely ignores false negatives
Because the arithmetic mean cannot be computed for ratios
content.answer: Because the harmonic mean gives attention to the lower value, whether it is precision or recall
